model.name: IFHAS Preventive Screening Initiative
model.documentation: ArchiMate model for IFHAS (Integrated Family Health and Screening) initiative for Abu Dhabi Department of Health

element.name: Implement digital eligibility checks and booking via Sahatna
Integrate Sahatna with EMRs for booking
Maintain IFHAS facility list via Accela
Filter facilities using DOH licensing flags
Enable early detection through preventive screening
Centralize eligibility and package data via APIs
Enable proactive engagement using insurance data
Clearly flag IFHAS services and encounters
Citizens can view results in Sahatna
